interpretations: For each rating, count rental transactions; select ratings whose counts exceed the mean of the five rating counts; return the mean count for selected ratings and its difference from the overall mean
For each rating, calculate the average number of rentals per film; select ratings above the mean of those five averages; return the mean selected average and its difference from the overall mean

For each rating, calculate the average number of rentals per inventory copy; select ratings above the mean of those five averages; return the mean selected average and its difference from the overall mean
For each rating, count distinct films that were rented; select ratings whose counts exceed the mean of the five counts; return the mean selected count and its difference from the overall mean

For each rating, count distinct inventory copies that were rented; select ratings whose counts exceed the mean of the five counts; return the mean selected count and its difference from the overall mean
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS mean_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(rc.rental_count) AS mean_selected_count,
  AVG(rc.rental_count) - om.mean_count AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE rc.rental_count > om.mean_count

WITH film_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_count) AS avg_rentals_per_film
  FROM film_rentals
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rentals_per_film) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ra.avg_rentals_per_film) AS mean_selected_average,
  AVG(ra.avg_rentals_per_film) - o.overall_mean AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ra.avg_rentals_per_film > o.overall_mean

WITH copy_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, i.inventory_id, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating, i.inventory_id
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rentals) AS average_rentals
  FROM copy_rentals
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rentals) AS mean_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ra.average_rentals) AS mean_selected_average,
  AVG(ra.average_rentals) - om.mean_average AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE ra.average_rentals > om.mean_average

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(film_count) AS mean_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(rc.film_count) AS mean_selected_count,
  AVG(rc.film_count) - o.mean_count AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.film_count > o.mean_count

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rental_id IS NOT NULL THEN i.inventory_id END) AS rented_copies
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rented_copies) AS mean_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT AVG(rc.rented_copies) AS mean_selected_count,
       AVG(rc.rented_copies) - o.mean_count AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rented_copies > o.mean_count
